@everyone

We are excited to announce that our public equity raise through http://republic.com/ is approaching launch. Here's everything you need to know before it does.

What this is. Republic is a regulated investment platform with 3 million community members, $2.6 billion in capital deployed, 3,000+ raises supported, and 27 portfolio unicorns, including the public equity raise from Skybound Entertainment (The Walking Dead, Invincible).

Who can invest:


US investors: must be accredited under SEC rules — generally, $200K+ annual income (or $300K+ joint) for the past two years, or $1M+ in net worth excluding your primary residence. Other categories also qualify (certain licensed professionals, knowledgeable employees, qualifying entities). Republic verifies accreditation during the investment process.
,
International investors: open in most countries without an accreditation requirement, subject to your local laws. Known exclusions: Ontario and British Columbia (Canada), and OFAC-sanctioned jurisdictions. Full details: https://republic.com/help/can-international-investors-invest-4.
,

If you're unsure whether you qualify, create the Republic account anyway — KYC and accreditation verification both happen inside the platform and will confirm your status before launch.

What you receive. A Crowd SAFE — a security that converts into equity in the studio behind Infinity Rising upon a qualifying future financing or liquidity event. Not a token. Not a skin. Not an in-game asset. A real ownership stake in the company, on standard institutional terms.

Key Info:

Minimum Investment: $250 USD
Payment Methods: Bank Wire | ACH | Credit/Debit Cards | USDC
Valuation: 


First $250,000 invested is provided at a discounted valuation of $15 million USD,
,
Followed by $1,250,000 at a $20 million USD valuation
,

Why early matters. Republic surfaces high-momentum deals to its broader investor base. Rounds that build momentum early get covered, shared, and discovered by investors who've never heard of us — many of whom become long-term backers and players. Early traction helps; it doesn't determine outcomes, but it meaningfully improves them.

Do these three things today, before launch:


Create a free account at http://republic.com/
,
Complete identity verification (this can take hours to a couple of days — don't wait until launch day)
,
Link your funding source
,

When the deal goes live, you want to be able to invest in minutes, not in a panic. Official link coming soon.

---

For informational purposes only. This is not an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any securities except through Republic.com. The Crowd SAFE is offered under Rule 506(c) of Regulation D (US accredited investors) and Regulation S (non-US investors) of the Securities Act of 1933. Investing involves a high degree of risk, including loss of principal. Read the offering documents on the deal page before investing.

Infinity Rising — O.4.0 Release Notes
,
Major Features
,
Apartments & Housing
,
Apartments are now available to claim and build within the Solace Hub City.
,
Players can now visit the Skyland Real Estate Office to browse and claim available apartments.
,
Apartments can also be directly claimed from apartment keypad terminals located at apartment buildings throughout the city.
,
Five apartment tiers/rarities are now available, ranging from basic starter spaces to premium high-end residences.
,
The first apartment tier is free for all players unless they already own a larger premium apartment.
,
Apartment building functionality is now available, allowing players to construct and customize their own living spaces.
,
Apartments support co-building functionality, allowing multiple players to collaboratively help construct and decorate an apartment.
,
Only the apartment owner can sell placed building items.
,
Players assisting with construction can place new items, but must purchase those items using their own in-game funds.
,
Players can place walls, floors, ceilings, furniture, decorations, utilities, and more using the apartment building system.
,
For a full walkthrough of the apartment system, building workflow, and recommended building tips, please watch the O.4.0 Transmission video.
,


Civic Works & Missions
,
Added Civic Works terminals across all major locations throughout the world.
,
Civic Works serves as the primary access point for missions and contracts across the Republic.
,
Players can now access main quests, side missions, cargo contracts, delivery jobs, and additional activities through Civic Works terminals.
,
Civic Works helps centralize mission flow and player progression into a unified system accessible throughout major hubs and settlements.
,


Cargo Hauling
,
Added Cargo Hauling missions as a new gameplay feature.
,
Cargo Hauling allows players to accept hauling requests from NPCs across the world.
,
Players can pick up cargo shipments from designated cargo stations and transport them to delivery destinations throughout the Republic.
,
Upon successful delivery, players will receive payment covering both the cargo value and an additional delivery fee.
,
Cargo Hauling introduces an early foundation for logistics, transport, and player-driven economic gameplay within the world.
,


Delivery Missions
,
Added Delivery missions as a new fast-paced gameplay activity.
,
Players can now take on food delivery jobs for Burger Barn using specialized delivery drones.
,
Delivery missions require players to quickly transport food orders to multiple destinations across the world before time runs out.
,
Players must complete the full delivery interaction process at each stop to successfully finish orders.
,
Speed and efficiency matter — nobody wants cold food arriving late.
,
Delivery gameplay introduces a more active, time-sensitive mission type focused on traversal, navigation, and route optimization.
,

Progression & Careers
,
Added the first implementation of the player progression system.
,
Players can now earn XP and level up through gameplay activities across the world.
,
Leveling up grants Perk Points which can be spent on specialized career paths.
,
Initial career specializations are now available and unlock access to higher-tier crafting benches and discipline-specific progression.
,
Vocational Skills now level independently as players actively work within specific jobs and professions.
,
Increasing Vocational Skill levels can improve payouts, unlock progression opportunities, and provide additional job-related perks.
,
The progression system establishes the foundation for long-term player growth, specialization, and economic identity within the Republic.
,


Crafting
,
Added the first major implementation of the crafting system.
,
Through Career Progression, players can gain access to increasingly advanced crafting benches as they move up within their professions.
,
Players can now access Tier 1 crafting benches located throughout the world, especially within towns and settlements across Solace.
,
Apartment building progression now allows players to construct and place crafting benches up to Tier 3 within their own residences.
,
Crafting now includes hundreds of available recipes spanning multiple professions and disciplines.
,
Certain recipes must be unlocked through gameplay progression, exploration, or quest completion.
,
Some quests now reward exclusive recipe unlocks for players pursuing specialized crafting paths.
,
The crafting system forms a major foundation for the Republic economy, progression systems, and future player-driven industry.
,


Questing & Story
,
Added various new side quests throughout the world.
,
The Main Quest Intro Part 2 is now available and continues the early narrative progression for new players.
,
Players can continue uncovering more of the world, lore, and underlying mysteries through the expanding quest system.
,


PVP Arena
,
The PVP Arena has been significantly updated and expanded into a more structured mini-game experience.
,
The arena now includes dedicated team systems, spawning areas, match flow improvements, and enhanced combat structure.
,
Players can access the PVP Arena deep within the Hub City underground maintenance tunnels.
,
The updated arena experience is designed to support more organized competitive combat and repeatable player battles.
,
The PVP Arena is still considered a work in progress and will continue receiving polish, balancing, and additional features in future updates.
,


Criminal Justice System
,
Added the Criminal Justice system.
,
Players can now receive bounties for attacking other players or discharging weapons in restricted areas.
,
Security bots now actively patrol major locations and will respond to criminal activity by engaging hostile players.
,
Players now accumulate wanted levels that can escalate up to 5 stars depending on the severity of their actions.
,
Higher wanted levels result in increasingly aggressive security responses and greater enforcement pressure throughout protected areas.
,
The Criminal Justice system helps reinforce law, order, and risk within
,

Relic Quest World Event
,
Players can now participate in the Relic Quest world event.
,
Terra forces have begun attacking cargo vessels high above Solace, causing valuable debris and cargo to rain down across the region.
,
Players can search the world for downed cargo containers, relics, and scattered goods from destroyed vessels.
,
Recovered items can be delivered to the Antique Shop within the Solace Hub City.
,
Maxwell Calder acts as a fixer for an exclusive client whose cargo was lost during the attacks.
,
Players will be well compensated for recovering valuable goods, especially for certain items that require a bit of discretion.
,
The Relic Quest introduces an ongoing world event focused on exploration, scavenging, discovery, and emergent world storytelling.
,


Improvements & Optimizations
,
Major multiplayer synchronization and networking improvements.
,
Reduced packet overhead and improved responsiveness in larger player groups.
,
Improved player interaction responsiveness and overall multiplayer smoothness.
,
Additional performance and stability improvements across the game.
,


Known Issues
,
All player data has been wiped for the O.4.0 release.
,


A bug may cause some players to become stuck in an avatar creation loop due to residual local player data.
,


To avoid this issue, players should wipe their Inventory and Progress data from the Character dropdown menu on the Main Menu before entering the game, especially if the issue occurs.
,


Release information aboard the Elysian Ship located within Calido Resort is currently out of date and will be corrected in an upcoming hotfix.
,


Transport traveling from Calido Resort to Solace has a chance of ejecting players into the air if standing too close to the front of the vehicle during travel.
,


Players are advised to remain toward the rear of the transport until this issue is resolved.
,


In certain edge-case scenarios, players may discover ways to build outside of intended apartment boundaries.
,


This issue is known and will be addressed in a future update.
,


Some player synchronization issues may still occur in highly populated areas.
,


Additional optimization work is ongoing throughout the world.
,


Some systems and gameplay features are still actively under development and subject to change during Early Access.
,
